about_the_game:
In 499 BC, you are hunted by your own people.
Rasna is a single-player, story-driven historical open-world game presented as a “Historically Accurate Etruscan Tale”. This means it strives for meticulous historical accuracy while immersing the player in a world rich with mysterious places, magical creatures, and ancient mythology.
Rasna is designed for players who love story-driven experiences, historical settings, and meaningful choices.

The player assumes the role of Velia, a young woman and daughter of the Lucumon (king) of the Etruscan city of Manthura. 
At the beginning of the game, something terrible happens and Velia becomes an outcast, hunted by her own fellow citizens.

Choices have consequences.

The game can end prematurely in 14 different ways, or reach the story’s conclusion through three distinct endings.

Dialogues require continuous player interaction and offer numerous choices. This makes it impossible to tell which decisions will truly affect the story, and which simply help define the personality you wish to give the protagonist.

To improve immersion, side quests are fully woven into the main one and are intentionally indistinguishable from it. Choices made during these missions can directly influence the outcome of the story.

Each character Velia encounters has a personal backstory, adding depth and richness to the narrative. It is up to you to decide whether to explore a conversation in depth or bring it to a close more quickly.

Gameplay and Combat System

Our goal is to offer highly varied gameplay: exploration, investigation, dialogue and diplomacy, combat, stealth, and the challenge of finding your way through complex environments.

As the story unfolds, you will find yourself in very different situations, each requiring a distinct approach.

At present, the combat system is still in development and not yet available. The Early Access release will only take place once the combat gameplay is ready for testing.

Combat philosophy: in our pursuit of maximum immersion, our goal is to create a combat system that is highly intuitive and focuses on tactical awareness and the ability to read the situation, rather than mechanical complexity. 

Historical Accuracy vs Fantasy

According to ancient Mediterranean legends and mythology, humans do not possess magic. However, there are magical creatures they may encounter, and a spiritual world that influences the forces of nature around them.

As the protagonist of an Etruscan tale, you will occasionally encounter magic and magical beings. They may be allies, neutral presences, or enemies, but you will not gain access to fantasy powers like fireballs, lightning bolts, etc.

Rasna is not “Etruscan” only in its aesthetics. In its own way, it aims to let players experience the world as an Etruscan might have seen and understood it.

The game takes place in an actual 3,600-hectare (9,000-acre) geographical region, recreated as it might have appeared 2,500 years ago.

All the major archaeological sites in this area have been recreated in the game.

The world is entirely handcrafted. No areas are procedurally generated.

About the developers

Rasna is developed by a team of only two developers, Matteo and Lorenzo, with the support of a few friends, volunteers, and a composer.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of fantasy violence, including melee combat and the use of bows and arrows.
Dialogues include references to violence, including murder and execution.
Alcohol consumption (wine) appears in certain social contexts.

name: Rasna

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-Bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 (3.3Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-Bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 (3.2Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (3.6 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 2080 or AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT or INTEL Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: "Rasna" is an historically accurate Etruscan tale: a legend as it might have been told in ancient times when people gathered around the fire. A single-player, story-driven historical open-world game to jump 2500 years in the past.
